title: Student Transportation Services: Fee-Waiver Adjustments on Courtesy Rider Permit Fees
content:
Student Transportation Services makes the Calloway Creek ISD fee-waiver adjustment for courtesy rider permits under Board Policy FP(LOCAL) (TEC 11.158(b) fee waivers). The adjustment is posted by the transportation office as a billing correction credit against the permit fee of the assignment, on the day the transportation office finds it owed.

## When the adjustment is owed

A meal status that took effect after a courtesy rider permit fee posted never lowers or removes the meal-status waiver credit that fee already carries, and it applies to the next permit fee posted; when the status on file took effect after the fee's posting date and its waiver share is larger than the waiver share already credited on the fee, the fee is also corrected by the fee-waiver adjustment of this rule, and only in that case.

An adjustment that figures to zero, including every case outside that condition, is owed as nothing and posts no credit entry.

| Status on file in the student's School Nutrition Services Meal Account | Effect on a courtesy rider permit fee already posted |
|---|---|
| took effect on or before the fee's posting date | no fee-waiver adjustment; the waiver credit on the fee stands |
| took effect after the posting date, with a waiver share no larger than the share already credited | no fee-waiver adjustment; the waiver credit on the fee stands |
| took effect after the posting date, with a larger waiver share | the fee is corrected by the fee-waiver adjustment |

In every row the new status also applies to the next permit fee posted.

**Effect on the account.** One billing correction credit is booked on the assignment's billing history, linked to the permit fee it corrects and dated the day it is posted; the household's amount due on the assignment goes down by the credit.

## Invocation: `record_fee_correction_81e67279`

This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `record_fee_correction_81e67279` and then calls it. One call posts one billing correction credit against the courtesy rider permit fee of one student transportation assignment; nothing else on the assignment changes.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `transport_assignment_id` | the reference number of the student's transportation assignment whose permit fee is corrected, as returned by the transportation assignment lookup | identifier |
| `permit_fee_entry_id` | the reference number of the courtesy rider permit fee entry being corrected, exactly as shown on that fee in the assignment's billing history lookup; it must be a permit fee entry of the same assignment | identifier |
| `adjustment_amount` | the correction credited against the permit fee, in US dollars | a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; recorded exactly as given |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new credit entry's reference number (an opaque id beginning `tlc_`), the assignment reference number, the permit fee entry it is linked to, the credited amount in US dollars with two decimals and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD).

**Errors.** A message beginning "Error:" means nothing was posted: the adjustment amount was not a positive amount with at most two decimal places, or the permit fee entry given is not a permit fee entry of the named assignment.
